title: Crayons Bridge production migration history to repository source map
source_policy: This is a read-only source availability map. CANDIDATE_ONLY and VERSION_DIVERGENCE do not establish SQL equivalence. No migration is safe to mark applied based on this map alone.

statuses.EXACT_MATCH: The current repository contains an exact matching migration version and source SQL.
statuses.CANDIDATE_ONLY: A semantically related local file exists, but exact SQL equivalence, ordering, grants, policies and side effects are not established.
statuses.VERSION_DIVERGENCE: A related current file exists, but its timestamp differs from the recorded production migration version.
statuses.MISSING_SOURCE: No exact source file was identified in the current repository tree.

required_before_replay: Recover the exact SQL for every MISSING_SOURCE version from authoritative PRs/commits or Supabase migration artifacts.
Diff all CANDIDATE_ONLY and VERSION_DIVERGENCE sources against the exact SQL that was applied.
Reconcile the current duplicate local version prefix 20261006230000 without changing historical meaning.
Resolve the conflict between legacy 0018_bridge_service_revenue_engine.sql and the newer commercial engine before selecting one canonical schema path.
Replay the complete ordered chain on a disposable PostgreSQL 17/Supabase environment and verify tables, columns, constraints, indexes, functions, grants, RLS policies and extension placement.
Only after the replay passes, prepare a separate test-only migration apply workflow with target assertions and test-only credentials.
